name: z0rd0nlander
description: Every Claude Code plugin, skill and agent by z0rd0n88, in one marketplace. Each plugin stays in its own repo.

plugins.name: think-time
plugins.description: Skills for ideation, critique, strategic analysis, comparison, hackathon idea generation and judging, and usage reflection.

plugins.name: idea-autopsy
plugins.description: Evidence-based idea assessment, user decisions, and agent-written revisions across four connected skills.

plugins.name: idea-autopsy-business
plugins.description: The business-proposal edition of idea-autopsy: evidence-based assessment, user decisions, and agent-written revisions.

plugins.name: lil-pstack
plugins.description: Lean fork of pstack-claude: hand-picked skills for PR shepherding, context recall, blast-radius analysis, subsystem explainers and adversarial review.

plugins.name: mod-divider
plugins.description: Draws a divider line, in a character you choose, between the bands other mods show above the prompt.

plugins.name: github-panel
plugins.description: GitHub issues assigned to you, in a pane inside Claude Code and Claude Desktop. A button above the prompt toggles it.

plugins.name: compact-courier
plugins.description: A Compact button in the prompt footer: Haiku summarizes the session in detail and that summary becomes the compaction.

plugins.name: next-action-hero
plugins.description: Buttons above the prompt for the choices Claude's last reply offered: yes/no, A/B/C, list items, Next: lines. A click sends that choice as your prompt.

plugins.name: fraktur-footer
plugins.description: Draws the prompt footer's mode labels (focus, memory paused) in the Fraktur letters of the GH and Compact buttons.

plugins.name: jev-pruner
plugins.description: Trims long Bash output with Jev through OpenRouter before the model sees it.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Jev skills (ask-jev, hyper-jev), the jev and ask-jev-files CLIs, and opt-in skill router, Scope Sentinel and compaction advisor hooks.

plugins.name: blast-off
plugins.description: Runs a multi-phase coding job unattended overnight as a chain of Claude sessions under systemd.

plugins.name: yt-eval
plugins.description: Turns YouTube videos into a fact-checked writeup, or just their transcript.

plugins.name: my-skills
plugins.description: Personal agent skills, plus credited copies of addyosmani, Iron-Ham and mattpocock skills.

plugins.name: inventory
plugins.description: Writes .CLAUDE.inventory.md: every hook, skill, plugin, agent and MCP server Claude Code runs, by scope, tagged installed or custom.
